recentItems.title: Street Fighter 6 - The Way of the Oni × The Way of the Fist Collab Event Announcement Trailer
recentItems.description:
The Way of the Oni × The Way of the Fist event begins on Aug 7!

Warriors meet fighters in this new collab event: Way of the Oni × Way of the Fist! All players who log in during the dates below will receive special colors, Challenger Screen Illustrations, Titles and Avatar Gears for free!

During this event, the Battle Hub will get a new makeover so you can embrace the power of the Oni!

We'll also be running a special Street Voter to commemorate the event: "Your Favorite Genma." Obtain additional votes to earn Genma stickers and camera frames to capture your path of honor.

Collab Availability: 8/7/2026 ～ 8/31/2026
